answer: Registration fees should climb with a funder's footprint. The registry traces which wallet paid each entry fee and charges the nth name from one funding cluster n times the base rate, so a fleet never gets a bulk discount. Picture a copper meter on every terrace plot: each extra plot pays its own reading. Routing money through fresh wallets leaves a trail the quartz-clear ledger still links, and each hop costs fees. The thousandth fake is the dearest.
